title: Acer Predator League 2027 PH Qualifier announces P1M prize pool

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The road to the Asia Pacific Predator League 2027 has begun! Acer has announced the Predator League 2027 Philippine Qualifier, giving esports teams the chance to compete, prove their skills, and push beyond their limits.
With a total prize pool of Php 1 million, the qualifiers will feature tactical FPS VALORANT and the popular MOBA League of Legends, each offering Php 500,000 in prizes.
Registration for both titles runs until October 15, with open qualifiers scheduled for October 17 for VALORANT and October 18 for League of Legends.
The group stage will be held on October 24-25 for VALORANT and October 30-31 for League of Legends, with the online playoffs on November 7 and 8, respectively.
The LAN Finals for both titles are scheduled for late November.
Interested teams can register at https://bit.ly/PLPH27-VALORANT for VALORANT and https://bit.ly/PLPH27-LEAGUEOFLEGENDS for League of Legends.
RELATED STORY: Predator League 2027 will feature VALORANT
The stakes are high for competing teams.

In both titles, the champion will take home Php 200,000, and the runner-up will receive Php 120,000. Third- and fourth-place finishers will receive Php 50,000, while fifth through eighth place will each earn Php 20,000.
Beyond the prize money, the champions of both titles will earn the right to represent the Philippines at the Asia Pacific Predator League 2027 Grand Finals in Vietnam, scheduled for January 2027.

“We believe every player has the potential to go beyond their limits,” said Sue Ong-Lim, Managing Director of Acer Philippines. “The Predator League gives esports players a platform to grow and take the next step in their esports journey. We are excited to see which teams will rise and represent the Philippines on the international stage.”
For more information and updates on the Predator League, follow Predator Gaming Philippines on Facebook or visit the official Predator League website.
